description:
Goal
The telemetry arc is complete only when every compiler2/fz2 production emitter passes existing raw semantic authorities and every handler derives or retains presentation data during its callback. With no handler, payload closures are not entered and the concrete NullTelemetry path can be erased.

Proven failure
The first positive grammar covered direct execute/event/span helpers but skipped ExecutionContext::emit_world_lazy and emit_world_event_lazy. A production spike proved that direct id.as_u32() was rejected in an adversarial fixture while identical World-wrapper scalarization passed. Adding both wrappers exposed 72 real violations across drive.rs and world.rs: field/method projections, casts, duplicated identifiers, and the telemetry_opaque adapter. The production path also includes compiler2, shared ir_codegen, aot_link, fz2/diagnostics, runtime, ir_interp, and lexer emitters.

Strategy
The guard accepts only literals/constants, raw function or pattern bindings, recursively raw aliases, immutable borrows, and one opaque(raw) wrapper. It rejects calls, methods, fields, casts, macros, indexing, aggregates, transformed aliases, eager dispatch/span bypasses, and duplicate metadata keys. Observer-free World mutation runs first; typed key-family helpers then receive already-existing semantic results as raw parameters. World-owned facts emit World plus a stable key and the direct changed result. Scheduler and return events emit raw JobCompletion and ActivationReturnDecision. Non-World owners emit their raw artifacts. Handler-only projections cover JSONL, dumps, diagnostics, process exit, lexer counts, runtime debug bytes, timeout, pull session, reusable cons, and codegen. Unconsumed ABI/callable/closure/receive/code-buffer summaries are deleted. BorrowedBytes represents event-scoped &[u8] without allocation; a retaining handler performs the copy.

Signal
The adversarial grammar includes iterator counts, tuple fields/casts, id scalarization, helpers, allocation, pre-bound projections, and closure-bound projections; the full production guard is green. The NullTelemetry JIT probe records zero handler projections. cargo test --lib passes 1,406 tests with 6 ignored and no failures. cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo check --all-targets, strict all-target/all-feature clippy, and cargo build --release --bin fz2 pass. The warm release build of fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz emits no diagnostics: no handler is 0.05s real / 0.07s user / 0.02s sys; JSON telemetry is 0.06s / 0.06s / 0.03s and writes 1,085 valid events / 270,541 bytes. The final diff deletes 1,915 lines and adds 1,912, with no added Rust comments, allowances, production shadow state, or telemetry-only traversal.
title: Migrate raw-authority telemetry handlers and audit event payloads
